name: Ink sketch
blurb: Wobbly brush line, hatching, googly eyes
mechanism: Every edge is a filled black brush polygon that swells from about 1 to 4.4 px and tapers to points, laid in a few separate strokes over a colour fill that slips 2 to 3.6 px past it, with dark areas hatched rather than filled.

palette.name: Blush tick alt
palette.role: blush ticks on a red character

line: Filled brush polygons only (no stroke attributes): outlines swell 1-4.4 px with taper; details 1.1-3.2; hatching 1.0-1.15 at -48 to -58 deg, spacing 2-3.2.
rules: Outlines are tapered brush strokes with one gap and one overshoot.
Fills slip 2-3.6 px past the line, with mottle and gloss.
Hatch shadows; never fill a dark area solid black.
Huge googly eyes, offset pupils, two specular dots each.
A critter or living object, never a person, on a grass patch.
Two to five ink hairs per stroke, nine to eleven flecks.
